node.title: BAND CHILD 2 (RH-AC): locate the rate-half adjacent crossing a_RH(q) on every unresolved row
node.statement: For every admissible rate-half row n=2^41, k=2^40, q=p^e with e in {1,...,6} and 2^167<q<2^256, determine the adjacent MCA crossing a_RH(q) satisfying B_mca(a_RH)<=floor(q/2^128)<B_mca(a_RH-1). The proved lower endpoint is k+2^34. On razor rows the proved direct-MCA Haboeck bounds give upper endpoints a_94=1563215236073 and, above the printed threshold, a_95=1563128173124. The far-CA/sparse crossing and adjacent unsafe witness remain open. In the strict-A=3 endpoint analysis, NEWCAP leaves a 9/4 residual. The old proposed FR spend 2m+2 was under-calibrated: the printed capacity route requires exactly floor((9m+1)m/(4m-1))+1, equal to 9m/4+1 officially. An incidence countermodel fences support-only FR, while a root-counting obstruction shows that countermodel has no coset-preserving apolar-biform lift. General algebraic control remains open.
node.attack_surface: Prioritize a collective theorem for arbitrary realizable shortened-apolar families or the common Hankel pencil, calibrated to outside spend 9m/4+1 (clean intersection at most 7m/4-2) at the NEWCAP endpoint. Do not continue the incidence-only FR route, prove only the insufficient old 2m+2 target, or re-audit the fenced quartic countermodel. Independently seek a beyond-Johnson direct MCA upper bound or an exact adjacent unsafe family. Preserve the q=p^e scope and do not substitute ordinary LIST supply for MCA without a proved beyond-half-distance conversion.
node.falsifier: An admissible row outside the printed bracket; a received word violating a proposed safe numerator; a claimed adjacent-unsafe family that fails exact slope count, endpoint, field, or ownership checks; or a purported FR proof using only the fenced incidence axioms.
